versions.name: RXV2-0.9.578-slider-help
versions.notes: Press and hold a slider's heading (Easy tuning, Governor, Rates, PIDs pages) to see exactly which numbers it moves and by how much; the Easy tuning help page lists them too.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.577-easy-tuning
versions.notes: New in À la carte: 'Easy tuning' - every plain-English slider in one place (how hard it starts, how agile, softer/sharper feel), a link under each to the page with the numbers, one Save that writes only what changed and verifies it. And the sliders now work backwards on the Governor, Rates and PIDs pages: type a number by hand and the slider moves to match.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.576-feel-sliders
versions.notes: Two more plain-English controls, numbers still visible underneath. Rates page: 'How agile?' - a Docile-to-Acrobatic slider sets the top rotation speeds (roll and pitch 120 to 500 deg/s, yaw 150 to 600) and a Soft-centre-to-Direct slider sets the expo on all three axes (Rotorflight rates type). PIDs page: 'Feel' - Cyclic and Tail sliders from softer to sharper scale this bank's P, I, D and feedforward together by up to 30 %, relative to what was loaded; wobbles or shakes = softer, sluggish or mushy = sharper; after a save the sliders return to centre.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.575-start-slider
versions.notes: Governor page: a slider 'How hard should it start?' from very gentle to very fierce sets spool-up time, handover throttle and startup time together (gentle = full head speed in 40 s with handover 10 %, fierce = 10 s and 25 %), and saving can switch PID spool-up on in every bank so the torque is even all the way up. The numbers stay visible underneath. Malcolm's idea, 2026-09-06.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.574-noreload
versions.notes: The PIDs, PID + and Rates pages lose their 'Reload from flight controller' button too (switching banks re-reads). The Governor (global) page keeps its one - it has no banks.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.573-gov-noreload
versions.notes: Governor profile page: the 'Reload from flight controller' button is gone (it sat under the Spool-up card and got hit by mistake); switching banks re-reads the bank anyway.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.572-arm-aux6
versions.notes: Arming channel learned from Rotorflight is now right: Rotorflight has five control channels, so its AUX1 is channel 6, not 5. Before this the receiver could pick the throttle channel as the arm switch, so 'armed' meant 'motor on' - radios went off with the motor and the landing wiggle came at motor-off while still armed. Check Receiver settings if you set the arming channel by hand.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.571-copy-hs
versions.notes: Copy a bank: new tick 'Adjust gains for the target bank's head speed'. Tune the middle bank, copy it outwards, and the copied P, I, D, feedforward and boost gains are scaled by the two banks' head speeds (control power grows with head speed squared): down fully for a faster bank, up more gently and never more than 25 % for a slower one. A note under the tick shows the change before you copy; the result names it afterwards. Malcolm's idea, 2026-09-05.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.570-arm-fast
versions.notes: Auto fly mode now switches Bluetooth and WiFi off half a second after the arm switch goes on (it was 3 s, which looked as if the motor switch did it). Same half-second bounce filter as the disarm side.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.569-card-wiggle
versions.notes: Two of Malcolm's suggestions. (1) The Rotorflight page's telemetry-speed card is now one quiet line - 'Telemetry: fast' - with the explanation under your finger (press and hold the underlined words), the Use standard / Use fast button as before. (2) The servo wiggle that announces 'the phone can connect' now also happens after a landing with the transmitter still on: as soon as the model is disarmed and the head speed reads zero, the chosen channel wiggles (a wiggle on a coasting rotor would yaw the model, so it waits for the stop - up to 90 s; without RPM telemetry, 30 s after disarming). Aborted wiggles now put the channel back exactly where it was.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.568-bank-putback2
versions.notes: Bank put-back, bench-proven on the Goblin and polished: a put-back no longer forgets which bank the phone had chosen (so a read arriving after a put-back really does get the phone's bank re-selected first), a save marks the flight controller's bank as unknown until re-read (Rotorflight re-applies the switch by itself right after every save), and the event log now says 'Boot banks saved back for the switch' when only the boot bank needed fixing.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.567-bank-putback
versions.notes: Banks go back to the transmitter's switch after a phone session. Rotorflight only re-applies a bank switch when the switch moves, so a tuning page that left the flight controller on another bank was flown on that bank until the switch moved. Now the receiver notes the switch's PID and rates banks before a page's first bank select, and 5 s after the phone goes quiet (transmitter off, disarmed) puts them back - and saves them as the boot banks if the session had saved on another bank. Never under a live transmitter (the switch owns the banks then; the event log says where the FC was left). Pages and apps see no difference: a request that arrives after a put-back gets its own bank re-selected first.
